_comment: Agent registry. Add a worker by appending an entry and deploying a matching runtime (Cloud Run Job, local daemon, or master-inline). No Master code changes — see registry.py and README 'Extending the registry'.

agents.name: echo-worker
agents.description: Placeholder worker. Echoes its input payload back as a typed result. Terminal — emits no relay messages.

agents.name: transform-worker
agents.description: Phase 2 second worker. Applies a text transform (upper/lower/reverse/count) and can relay its result through the Master to another agent.

agents.name: assistant
agents.description: Agentic assistant — a Claude tool-use loop that runs terminal commands on the operator's Mac to accomplish a natural-language goal. Read-only commands auto-run; anything else needs the operator's approval.

agents.name: mac-shell
agents.description: Runs shell commands on the operator's Mac via the outbound-only local agent. Every command is SENSITIVE — gated by the session window or per-command approval.

agents.name: cloudrun-admin
agents.description: Reads and manages Cloud Run via the Master's scoped service account. Works even when the Mac is offline. Read ops are benign; mutating ops are SENSITIVE.
